_readme: Street Scene driving parameters: the ONE file that holds every car physics number.
base: the shared tuning every car starts from (it is exactly the Proto Compact / protoCompact).

cars.<id>: per car overrides, merged over base. Write absolute values (e.g. "mass": 2000), only the keys that differ. Nested objects merge key by key, arrays (torqueCurve, ratios) replace the whole array.
Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored. Unknown keys fail loudly at startup, so typos never go unnoticed.
drivetrain.layout is "rwd", "awd" or "fwd". awdFrontShare is the AWD torque share sent to the front axle (0.4 = 40/60).
performanceParts: garage upgrade tiers, index 0 stock, 1 street, 2 pro, 3 extreme. applyBuild() in build.ts applies them over the car tuning.
Geometry (wheel positions, size) comes from src/assets/carManifest.json, not from here.
Test drive tuning panel: Copy JSON exports `fileOverride`, a block you can paste into cars.<id> here. Editing this file discards stale test drive tuning saved in the browser.

protoCompact._name: Proto Compact: front inline 6, rev happy, rear wheel drive. Uses base as is.

protoHatch._name: Proto Hatch: front turbo inline 4, front wheel drive. Lighter, a flat turbo torque plateau, shorter redline and a taller final drive; the front tires do all the work.

protoCoupe._name: Proto Coupe: front turbo V6, rear wheel drive. Heavier than the Compact, a big mid range turbo plateau that still revs out, longer gearing.

proto._name: Proto RS: procedural placeholder used by tests and the asset pipeline. Not selectable. Uses base as is.

traffic._: Ambient traffic (src/sim/traffic.ts): civilian cars driven kinematically along street lanes, keeping right, and solid passive bodies once struck. Speeds m/s, accelerations m/s^2, lengths m, masses kg.
traffic._loose: A struck car slides: lateral speed bleeds off at slideDecel, rolling speed at rollDecel, spin at spinDecel (rad/s^2). Stopped (under restSpeed) for recoverDelay s, it rejoins its lane when within rejoinDistance of it and rejoinYawDeg of its heading, blending the offset out over rejoinLength of driving.
traffic._kinds: Vehicle kinds: collision size (half length, half width) and mass; share is the spawn mix. The renderer draws a silhouette per name (render/traffic.ts).

driftZones._readme: Drift zones (src/sim/driftZones.ts): the monument plaza and the bigger parking lots. Drifting inside one counts drift points scoreMul times (drift mode) and refills nitrous refillMul times as fast (every mode, every car), for at most bonusTime s of drifting and refillCap of a tank per visit. A visit survives exitGrace s outside; once it ends the zone rests cooldown s before it pays that car again.
driftZones._lots: Parking lots count as zones from this size: depth into the block and frontage length (m), and area (m^2). Smaller lots are too tight to hold a slide.
